conclusion:[
"Production authority cannot be obtained from the current evidence struct or by installing the fixture verifier. Implement a sealed native authority path whose trust anchor is independent of request JSON.",
"Existing historical held-Job receipts are useful evidence, but are unsigned and their original handles are closed. They cannot become contemporaneous signed Root testimony retroactively.",
"Add a separate fixed schema23-to24 plan. Do not reuse the ordinary restore path unchanged: it converts QUEUED to RECONCILING and changes revisions/leases before migration.",
"Prefer an offline schema-only same-data-root production migration after encrypted backup and an isolated schema-only rehearsal. This preserves original business rows and makes the current abandonment CAS contract meaningful.",
"Fix the previously reported executor-wide profile-upload false positive before any claim of target-flow readiness."

authority_design:{
recommended_boundary:"A dedicated maintenance mode of the independently accepted apps/control binary, with no HTTP/native public listeners, no scheduler/coordinator launch and no provider setup. Ordinary CLI can request review, but cannot mint or inject capability.",
construction:[
"Keep preparedAbandonmentAuthority private and nil in New/NewCurrentMu and normal control startup. Never add an exported setter, configurable verifier callback, environment bypass, or a JSON field enabling authority.",
"Implement an internal leaf package for concrete Windows recovery authority, with no domain dependency. Domain can import its opaque concrete token type; apps/control can obtain that token only through its verified native bootstrap. An exported constructor must perform OS/cryptographic validation itself rather than accepting arbitrary expectedPeer, key or acceptedHash as the trust root.",
"Native acquisition independently verifies current accepted control image/build/source inventory against a frozen release anchor, current SID, data-root and database handle identities; holds DataRootLease (Borrow or equivalent full-operation lifetime lock), verifies exclusive SQLite owner in maintenance mode, and requires a private inherited peer-authenticated bootstrap.",
"Reuse the drain channel security pattern but define a distinct abandonment protocol/purpose, fresh random key/nonce, strict frame limit, single operation and exact Run/Task/epoch/expected revisions/manifest/proof digest. Authenticate both peer PID+creation+accepted image through OS; same-SID DACL alone is insufficient. Do not reuse drain HMAC key or permit cross-protocol frames.",
"Trust anchor remains an explicit implementation gate: an independently accepted native Root/supervisor process must provision the one-use capability. Request JSON, a caller-selected public key, a file path, a backup encryption key or a publicly invokable helper that mints capabilities for arbitrary callers cannot be that anchor.",
"Token has unexported fields, no JSON/gob deserialization constructor, process instance binding, root+database file identity, exact proof/tuple, expiry and one-use state; zero value rejects. Factory in domain accepts only this concrete token and constructs the private concrete verifier after checking it against Service DB identity. Existing unexported interface can remain as test seam, but no production arbitrary implementation is accepted.",
"Do signature/key/OS evidence loading outside the DB write transaction with source read guards. Recheck immutable token identity, lifetime, data-root lease and exact proof digest under resourceWriteLock immediately before CAS. Hold file handles/guard and lease until commit/rollback. Avoid a verifier that opens another DB connection while the write lock is held.",
"Token use and proof insert must have defined crash semantics: rollback permits only the same still-valid in-process token; committed duplicate proof reads existing immutable tombstone without reopening authority to another tuple. Restart requires a fresh authorized maintenance session and verifies the stored proof rather than auto-replaying an action."
],

This exception must be inaccessible to generic RestoreOptions/HTTP/CLI boolean options and allowed only under the concrete maintenance capability and exact plan.",

Rehearsal must not execute abandonment, create a tombstone or generate fake observation/financial rows.",
"After independent review and explicit production migration authorization, recheck source root/DB identity, exact schema23/logical inventory/release/binary pins and the rehearsal proof. Once committed, rollback strategy is a separately authorized restoration of the preserved backup, not deleting migration/proof records.",

Do not combine schema migration with Run FAILED or proof creation. Resume normal serving only after separate single-writer cutover/review."
